name: Vordek Coalvein
source_profile:
High Factor Vordek Coalvein (LE) — First Speaker of the Iron Council

Vordek is an aging and exceptionally wealthy duergar industrialist whose family controls several of the realm's largest foundries. A calculating administrator, he has maintained his position by satisfying the demands of the illithids while preserving enough prosperity to keep the duergar nobility loyal. Vordek privately despises his masters but considers resistance suicidal. He believes the duergar can eventually purchase greater independence through wealth, obedience, and patience.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 78 (source excerpt; may be partial)
